heic2any 0.0.4 (MIT license) - https://github.com/alexcorvi/heic2any
Used by EasyCut to open HEIC/HEIF (iPhone) photos on PC and Android. Loaded only when a HEIC photo is imported.

UTIF2 4.1.0 (MIT license) - https://www.npmjs.com/package/utif2
Used to decode TIFF/TIF photos. Copyright (c) 2017 Photopea. See UTIF-LICENSE.txt.

pako 1.0.11 (MIT license) - https://github.com/nodeca/pako
Inflate support used by the TIFF decoder. See pako-LICENSE.txt.
